entries.title: Neural Archon / clean night sky and unboxed lightning storm
entries.note: Fresh actual native Furious4510HP Neural Archon checkpoint. Other lives cleared before filming; invulnerable input-only observer, native weapons and no recorder HP/phase/clock writes. Clean midnight sky/cloud parallax. Storm uses54 authored caster glow poses and one actual metal ground warning; no per-eruption rectangles. Committed varied lightning eruptions retain a clear flank, native source-alpha damage and staggered thunder. Scenery darkens during casting/storm and recovers. Full-width warm eye beams and finite cloud shield remain. Native copied-life defeat included; separate Normal/Hard/Furious tests verify both ordinary-movement storm escapes without GOD.
